project: Wuxia Life P77 Renown Payoff Playable Implementation
description: Implement the renown payoff stage (人情债之解) for jianghu_renown_sage tavern_hand seed — runtime choice event wiring, expression updates for all 3 choices, targeted proof, and regression tests. Strictly follows P76 payoff contract.

userStories.title: Wire renown payoff spine event
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the renown payoff event wired through the existing event system so players on the renown route encounter a real payoff milestone with meaningful choices.
acceptanceCriteria: Configure renown_midlife_payoff choice event in sample-lines-spine.json
Trigger conditions: renown_midlife_pressure_done + age 43-47 + exclusivity guard + no orthodox/demonic
Set renown_midlife_payoff_done checkpoint flag + renown_age40_identity_done
Set choice-specific markers: tavern_renown_payoff_hard_holder / tavern_renown_payoff_breaker / tavern_renown_payoff_balancer
Correct stat changes per choice: A(rep+5,con+3,cha+2) / B(rep-2,con-4,cha-1) / C(rep+2,con+1,cha+3)
No new event framework or scheduler
P71/P72/P73/P75 existing evidence does not regress

userStories.title: Add payoff player-facing expression — sample line (core P0)
userStories.description: As a player, I want the renown payoff choice reflected in my sample line status so the route feels like it has a meaningful identity turning point.
acceptanceCriteria: Sample line cost label: pressure state → payoff state (声名之累 / 快意恩仇 / 人情练达)
Sample line current goal: pressure state → payoff state (硬扛 / 撕破脸 / 找平衡)
At least 2 payoff-specific readable signals (cost label + current goal)
Three choices have meaningfully different expressions, not reskinned
Preserve tavern-born renown flavor
No new UI components

userStories.title: Add payoff player-facing expression — age-40 identity (core P0)
userStories.description: As a player, I want an age-40 identity summary that reflects my payoff choice so the midlife turning point feels like it defines who I am.
acceptanceCriteria: renownAge40Identity() returns corresponding identity text after payoff
Option A: 硬撑面子的江湖好人
Option B: 快意恩仇的独行侠
Option C: 人情练达的江湖名宿
Three choices have meaningfully different identity descriptions
Preserve tavern-born renown flavor

userStories.title: Add payoff player-facing expression — ordinary origin (bonus P1)
userStories.description: As a player, I want additional payoff-specific expressions in the ordinary origin view so the payoff stage feels richer and more memorable.
acceptanceCriteria: Ordinary origin current goal: payoff state update (consistent with sample line)
Ordinary origin life memory: payoff-specific text (different per choice)
Ordinary origin summary: payoff state update (different per choice)
Preserve tavern-born renown flavor
No new UI components

userStories.title: Add targeted payoff proof
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a bounded proof artifact showing that the renown payoff event fires correctly, all three choices work, and tavern-born renown flavor is preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce 1 targeted proof (pressure → payoff → expression changes path verification)

Show 11 core nodes: pre-payoff baseline → event fires → 3 choices visible → Option A flags → Option A stats → Option B flags → Option B stats → Option C flags → Option C stats → cost label per choice → current goal per choice
Optional bonus nodes: age-40 identity, life memory, origin summary, full chain traceback, mutex with other lines
No full lifetime exhaust required
Proof supports whether to continue late-life stage decision
Save as docs/test-reports/p77-renown-payoff-targeted-proof.md

userStories.title: Add narrow regression coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want narrow tests guarding the renown payoff stage so future edits do not break the first renown payoff milestone.
acceptanceCriteria: New test file covering payoff stage
Group 1: Event wiring (4 tests) — existence, choice type, 3 options, conditions, age range
Group 2: Pre-payoff state (2 tests) — state verification after pressure before payoff
Group 3: Option A post-payoff (4 tests) — flags + stats + cost label + current goal
Group 4: Option B post-payoff (4 tests) — flags + stats + cost label + current goal
Group 5: Option C post-payoff (4 tests) — flags + stats + cost label + current goal
Group 6: Distinct from merchant payoff (2 tests)
Group 7: No regression of P71/P72/P73/P75 (5 tests)
Reuse existing test harness
All relevant commands pass

userStories.title: Produce P77 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report stating exactly what the renown payoff stage now provides and whether late-life stage is justified next.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p77-renown-payoff-closure-report.md
Summarize event wiring, expressions, proof, tests
State whether subsequent late-life stage is worth opening
List larger renown-expansion items that remain deferred
All 9 closure criteria satisfied (from P76 validation shape)
